prompt: hey can you help me set up a Schedule Trigger that runs every weekday at 9am and sends a good morning message to our #general Slack channel
I need a simple workflow that watches for new emails in Gmail and forwards them to a Telegram bot
whats the best way to set up a webhook that receives JSON data and inserts it into a Postgres table
can you build me a flow that reads all rows from a Google Sheet and creates a Notion page for each one
I want to send a Discord message every time a new record is added to my Airtable base
set up a cron job that hits my API health endpoint every 10 minutes using HTTP Request and logs the response to a Google Sheet
build a workflow that takes a file uploaded via webhook and saves it to Google Drive
I need to send a Telegram notification whenever a new row appears in my Google Sheet
help me create a workflow that receives a webhook from Stripe and logs the event type and amount to a Google Sheet
can you set up a flow that checks an RSS feed every 30 minutes and posts new items to a Slack channel
I want to use the HTTP Request node to call a REST API with bearer token auth and save the JSON response into Airtable
build me a quick workflow where a manual trigger pulls data from Postgres and sends it as a CSV attachment via Gmail
set up a form trigger that collects name and email, then adds the submission to a Google Sheet
I need a workflow that runs daily and backs up a MySQL table to a Google Sheets spreadsheet
create a workflow that listens for GitHub push events via webhook and sends a summary to our dev Slack channel

I need a workflow where a webhook receives customer feedback, uses an IF node to check the sentiment score, and routes positive feedback to a Google Sheet but negative feedback creates a Jira ticket and sends a Slack alert

build me a flow that pulls new Shopify orders via HTTP Request, uses a Code node to calculate tax and shipping totals, then updates our Postgres inventory table and sends an order confirmation via Gmail
I want to create a workflow that watches a Gmail inbox for emails with attachments, downloads the attachments, uploads them to Google Drive, then sends a Slack notification with the file link
help me build an approval workflow where a form submission goes to a manager via Slack interactive message, and based on their response either creates a record in Notion or sends a rejection email
set up a workflow that pulls data from two different Google Sheets, merges them on a shared email column using the Merge node, then deduplicates and writes the combined result to a third sheet
I need to pull user data from our REST API using HTTP Request, filter out inactive users with an IF node, transform the data with a Set node, then create contacts in HubSpot for each active user
build a workflow that monitors a Supabase table for new rows using a schedule trigger, checks if the record already exists in Airtable, and if not creates it, otherwise updates the existing record

whats the best way to build a workflow that receives webhook data, validates required fields using a Code node, and either processes valid data into Postgres or returns a 400 error response to the webhook caller

I need a workflow that every morning queries Postgres for overdue invoices, groups them by customer using a Code node, and sends each customer a personalized reminder email via Gmail with their list of overdue items

can you help me set up a workflow that receives a CSV file via webhook, parses it with the Spreadsheet File node, validates each row, and creates or updates records in Salesforce based on whether the email already exists

build me a social media scheduling workflow that reads posts from a Notion database, uses an IF node to check the scheduled date, and on the right day posts to Twitter via HTTP Request and updates the Notion status to published

I want to set up a workflow that uses the Cron trigger to run every hour, pulls new entries from an RSS feed, checks each against a Google Sheet to avoid duplicates, and sends only new ones to a Telegram channel

help me create a workflow that receives a Typeform submission via webhook, enriches the data by calling Clearbit API via HTTP Request, scores the lead using a Switch node, then routes to different Slack channels based on score tier

I need a data cleanup workflow that reads from a Google Sheet, uses a Code node to normalize phone numbers and email addresses, removes duplicates with the Remove Duplicates node, and writes the clean data back to a new sheet

build a monitoring workflow where a Schedule Trigger checks five different API endpoints using HTTP Request nodes in parallel, compares response times against thresholds with IF nodes, and sends a single Slack summary with any endpoints that are slow or down

I need to build a full customer onboarding pipeline. When a Stripe checkout.session.completed webhook fires, look up the customer in Postgres. If they are new, create their account, provision a Supabase project via API, generate API keys, send a welcome email via SendGrid with their credentials, add them to the right Slack channel, and create an onboarding checklist in Notion. If they are existing, just update their subscription tier and send an upgrade confirmation email. Add error handling that catches failures at each step and sends alerts to our ops Slack channel.

build me an AI-powered content pipeline that runs daily. It should scrape 10 industry RSS feeds, deduplicate articles, use OpenAI to summarize each article into 3 bullet points, then use a second OpenAI call to generate a LinkedIn post and a tweet for each summary. Save everything to a Notion database, post the tweets to Twitter via HTTP Request, and at the end generate a daily digest email sent via Gmail to our marketing team. Use Split In Batches to avoid rate limits on OpenAI.

hey I want to set up a multi-source lead aggregation system. Leads come in from three places: a webhook from our website form, a Typeform integration, and new contacts from HubSpot. Merge all three sources, deduplicate by email using a Code node, enrich each lead by calling the Clearbit API, use OpenAI to score and categorize the lead (enterprise vs SMB vs individual), then route enterprise leads to Salesforce and assign a sales rep, SMB leads to a Google Sheet for the inside sales team, and individual leads to a Mailchimp audience. Log everything to Postgres and send a daily summary to Slack.

I need to build a document processing workflow. A webhook receives uploaded PDFs. Use HTTP Request to send the PDF to a document parsing API, extract structured data with a Code node, validate required fields, then use OpenAI to classify the document type (invoice, contract, receipt, or other). Based on type: invoices go to our accounting system via API, contracts get saved to Google Drive and create a review task in Asana, receipts go to a Google Sheet. If classification confidence is below 80% route to a human review queue in Notion. Add retry logic for the parsing API and error notifications to Slack.

build a customer support AI agent workflow. It receives messages via webhook from our chat widget, looks up the customer in Postgres by their session ID, retrieves relevant docs from a Pinecone vector store, passes everything to an OpenAI agent with tools for searching our knowledge base, checking order status via HTTP Request to our API, and creating support tickets in Zendesk. The agent should have conversation memory using the Window Buffer Memory node. If the agent cant resolve the issue after 3 back-and-forths, escalate to a human by creating a ticket and notifying the support team on Slack. Log all conversations to Postgres.

I want to build a data sync pipeline between our Postgres database and Airtable that runs every 15 minutes. Pull changed records from both sides using timestamps, merge them matching on a shared ID field, use a Code node to detect conflicts by comparing updated_at timestamps, resolve conflicts by keeping the most recent version, write updates back to both systems, and log any unresolvable conflicts to a Google Sheet for manual review. Handle pagination for large result sets using Loop Over Items, and add error handling so one failed record doesnt stop the whole batch.

can you help me build a recruitment pipeline automation. When a new applicant submits via our careers page webhook, parse their resume by sending it to an API via HTTP Request, use OpenAI to extract skills and experience, score them against the job requirements stored in a Google Sheet, then route them through a Switch node: top candidates get a Calendly scheduling link emailed via Gmail and a Slack notification to the hiring manager, maybe candidates go into a review queue in Notion, and rejected ones get a polite rejection email. Create a record in our Postgres HR database for everyone, and send a weekly summary report to the hiring team.

I need an e-commerce returns processing workflow. A webhook receives return requests from our store. Look up the order in Postgres, verify the return window hasnt expired using a Code node, check inventory levels via HTTP Request to our warehouse API. If approved: update the order status in Postgres, initiate a refund via the Stripe API, send a return label email via SendGrid, update inventory in Google Sheets, and notify the warehouse team on Slack. If denied: send a denial email explaining why. Add error handling for the Stripe refund step with retry logic, and if the refund fails after 3 retries create a manual review ticket in Jira and alert the finance team on Slack.

build me a RAG chatbot with conversation memory. Set up a Chat Trigger, connect it to an AI Agent that uses OpenAI GPT-4 as the model. Give the agent tools: a Supabase Vector Store for searching our documentation, an HTTP Request tool for checking our API status, and a Calculator tool. Use Postgres Chat Memory so conversations persist across sessions. Add a system prompt that tells the agent its a helpful product support bot. When the user asks something the agent cant answer, have it create a ticket in Linear and respond that a human will follow up.

set up a comprehensive monitoring and alerting system. Every 5 minutes, check 8 different microservice health endpoints via HTTP Request nodes running in parallel. Use a Code node to aggregate results and calculate uptime percentages. Store metrics in Postgres with timestamps. Use IF nodes to detect: individual service down, multiple services down, or response time degradation. For individual service down send a Slack message to the team channel. For multiple services down page the on-call via PagerDuty API. For degradation trend post to a separate analytics Slack channel. Every morning at 9am generate a daily uptime report from Postgres data and email it via Gmail to the engineering leads.

I need a multi-step AI research agent. A webhook receives a research question. The first AI agent generates 5 search queries, each query gets executed via SerpAPI HTTP requests, a second AI agent evaluates the search results for relevance and credibility, then a third AI agent synthesizes everything into a structured research report with citations. Save the report to Google Drive as a Google Doc using the Google Docs node, send a summary to Slack, and store the full research session in Postgres for future reference. Handle rate limits on the search API with appropriate delays using the Wait node.

build an automated invoice processing pipeline. Watch a Gmail inbox for emails with invoice attachments. Download the attachment, send it to an OCR API via HTTP Request, extract invoice details with a Code node (vendor name, amount, due date, line items). Use OpenAI to categorize the expense type and check for anomalies. Look up the vendor in our Postgres vendor database. If the vendor exists and the amount is under the auto-approval threshold from a config Google Sheet, auto-approve and create a payment record in our accounting API. Otherwise route to a manager for approval via Slack interactive message. Track everything in Airtable and send a weekly expense summary report via email.

I want to build an employee offboarding workflow. When HR marks someone as terminated in our system (detected via webhook), the workflow should: disable their Google Workspace account via Admin API, remove them from all Slack channels, revoke their GitHub org access via API, transfer ownership of their Google Drive files to their manager, archive their Notion workspace, update their status in Postgres, send a confirmation to HR via email, and notify IT on Slack with a checklist of manual steps remaining. Each step should have error handling that continues even if one step fails, and at the end send a summary of what succeeded and what failed.

create a competitive intelligence workflow that runs weekly. Use HTTP Request to scrape competitor pricing pages (5 competitors), extract pricing data using Code nodes, compare against our current pricing stored in a Google Sheet, use OpenAI to analyze trends and generate insights, store historical pricing data in Postgres for trend analysis, generate a comparison report saved to Google Drive, and send a Slack notification with key findings to the strategy channel. Handle cases where competitor pages change structure by using a fallback parsing strategy and alerting when extraction fails.

help me set up an AI-powered email triage system. Watch my Gmail inbox for new messages. Use OpenAI to classify each email into categories: urgent-action-required, needs-reply, informational, or spam. For urgent emails send an immediate Slack DM to me with the subject and summary. For needs-reply ones use a second OpenAI call to draft a response and save it to Gmail drafts. For informational ones add a row to a Google Sheet digest organized by topic. For spam label and archive them. Use a Code node to track response time metrics, store everything in Postgres, and send me a daily report at 6pm with stats on email volume by category and average response time.

I need to build a workflow that handles incoming support tickets from multiple channels. A Slack bot receives messages in our support channel, a webhook receives tickets from our website, and another webhook catches emails forwarded from our support inbox. Normalize all three formats with a Code node, deduplicate by checking against Postgres, use an OpenAI agent with our product docs as a vector store tool to auto-respond to common questions, route complex issues to the right team using a Switch node based on the AI classification, create tickets in Linear for engineering issues and Zendesk for customer issues, and track SLA timers using a Wait node that triggers an escalation if no response within 2 hours.

build a multi-channel notification system with preferences. A webhook receives event data. Look up user notification preferences from a Postgres table. Based on preferences, send via any combination of: email through Gmail, Slack DM, Telegram message, Discord notification, or SMS via Twilio HTTP Request. Use a Loop Over Items node to process each users preferences, a Switch node for channel routing, and a Code node to format messages differently per channel. Batch Slack messages to avoid rate limits. Log delivery status for each notification in Postgres and retry failed deliveries up to 3 times with exponential backoff using the Wait node.

set up an automated blog publishing pipeline. A webhook receives a topic idea. An AI agent researches the topic using web search via SerpAPI, generates an outline, writes the full article using OpenAI with a custom system prompt for our brand voice, generates an SEO meta description with a second prompt, creates a featured image prompt and sends it to DALL-E via the OpenAI node, uploads the image to our CDN via HTTP Request, creates the blog post in WordPress via REST API, adds it to our content calendar in Notion, and shares it on social media. Include a human review step where the draft is sent to Slack for approval before publishing.

help me build a data pipeline that extracts data from a paginated REST API. The API returns 100 records per page with a cursor token for the next page. Use an HTTP Request node inside a Loop Over Items to paginate through all results, accumulate them using a Code node, transform the data using Set nodes to match our schema, validate each record, split valid and invalid records with an IF node, bulk insert valid records into Postgres using batch operations, log invalid records to a Google Sheet with the validation errors, send a completion summary to Slack, and handle API rate limiting with a Wait node between batches.

I want to create an AI agent that can manage my calendar. Set up a Chat Trigger connected to an AI Agent with OpenAI GPT-4o. Give the agent tools: Google Calendar for checking availability and creating events, Gmail for sending meeting invitations and follow-ups, a Code tool that calculates timezone conversions, and an HTTP Request tool for looking up contacts in our CRM. The agent should use Window Buffer Memory to remember context within a conversation. Add a system prompt explaining it should ask clarifying questions if the meeting details are vague, suggest optimal times based on existing calendar, and always confirm before creating events.

build a workflow that processes incoming orders from multiple marketplaces. Webhooks receive orders from Shopify, WooCommerce, and Amazon. A Code node normalizes the different order formats into a standard schema. Check inventory in Postgres. If in stock: create a shipping label via ShipStation API, update inventory, send order confirmation email via SendGrid, and update the marketplace order status via their respective APIs. If out of stock: notify the purchasing team on Slack, place the order in a backorder queue in Postgres, and send the customer a delay notification email. Use error handling on each marketplace API call since they have different error formats.

create an automated testing and deployment notification workflow. When a GitHub webhook fires for a push to main, use HTTP Request to trigger our CI pipeline, then poll the CI status endpoint every 30 seconds using Loop Over Items and Wait nodes until the build completes or times out after 10 minutes. On success: post a green checkmark to the PR Slack thread, update the deployment log in Google Sheets, tag the commit via GitHub API. On failure: post the error details to Slack with the failing test names extracted via Code node, create a bug ticket in Jira with the build log, and notify the author via email. Track deployment frequency metrics in Postgres.

I need to build a content moderation pipeline for user-generated content. A webhook receives new submissions. Run them through three checks in parallel using separate branches: OpenAI for text policy compliance, an image moderation API via HTTP Request for image safety, and a Code node for basic pattern matching against a blocklist stored in Google Sheets. Merge the results, and if any check fails route to a human moderation queue in Notion. If all pass auto-publish via our CMS API. For borderline cases (OpenAI confidence between 60-85%) send to a senior moderator Slack channel. Log all moderation decisions to Postgres for audit trail and compliance reporting.

help me set up a financial reconciliation workflow. Every day at midnight pull transactions from Stripe via API and from our Postgres ledger. Use a Merge node to match transactions by ID. Use a Code node to identify discrepancies: missing in one system, amount mismatches, or duplicate charges. For each discrepancy type use a Switch node to route to the appropriate handler: missing transactions get auto-created in the lagging system, amount mismatches get logged to a Google Sheet for manual review and trigger a Slack alert to the finance team, duplicates get flagged and a refund is auto-initiated via Stripe API if under $50. Generate a daily reconciliation report and email it to the CFO via Gmail.

build an AI-powered meeting notes workflow. After each Google Calendar event that has a Zoom link, wait 10 minutes for the recording, then download the transcript via Zoom API using HTTP Request. Send the transcript to OpenAI to generate a structured summary with action items, decisions made, and follow-ups. Create a Notion page with the meeting notes organized by those categories. For each action item, create a task in Asana assigned to the person mentioned. Send a Slack message to the meeting channel with the summary. Store the raw transcript and structured notes in Postgres. If the transcript is too long for one OpenAI call, split it into chunks using a Code node and process sequentially.

I need a workflow for automated vendor onboarding. A webhook receives new vendor applications. Validate required documents are present, verify their business registration by calling a government API via HTTP Request, run a credit check via another API, use OpenAI to analyze their proposal against our requirements stored in Google Sheets, then score and categorize them. High-score vendors get auto-approved: create records in Postgres, send credentials via email, add them to our vendor portal via API. Medium-score go to review: create a task in Notion with the AI analysis. Low-score get auto-rejected with a polite email. Track the pipeline in Airtable and send weekly stats to Slack.

set up a workflow that syncs contacts between Salesforce and Mailchimp bidirectionally. Run every hour. Pull recently modified contacts from both systems, match on email, detect which side has newer data using timestamps, handle merge conflicts with a Code node that applies business rules (Salesforce wins for job title and company, Mailchimp wins for email preferences and tags), update both sides with the reconciled data, manage Mailchimp list segments based on Salesforce lead status, and log all sync operations to a Google Sheet. Use Split In Batches to handle large contact lists without hitting API limits, and add error handling per record so one failure doesnt stop the batch.

build a knowledge base ingestion pipeline. A webhook receives document URLs. Download the document via HTTP Request, detect the file type with a Code node, parse it differently based on type (PDF via parsing API, HTML via scraping, plain text directly). Chunk the content using a Code node with overlap, generate embeddings using OpenAI Embeddings, store them in a Supabase Vector Store for our RAG chatbot. Track all ingested documents in Postgres with metadata. If a document was previously ingested, delete old chunks and re-ingest. Send a Slack notification when ingestion completes with the document title and chunk count. Handle large documents by processing chunks in batches.

I want to automate our incident response process. A webhook receives alerts from our monitoring system. Use a Code node to parse the alert severity and affected service. For critical alerts: immediately page the on-call engineer via PagerDuty API, create an incident channel in Slack, post the alert details, start a status page update via HTTP Request to our Statuspage API, and create a Jira incident ticket. For warning alerts: post to the engineering Slack channel and create a Jira task. For info alerts: just log to Postgres. After the incident is resolved (detected via a follow-up webhook), auto-close the Jira ticket, update the status page, archive the Slack channel, and use OpenAI to generate a post-incident summary from the Slack channel messages.

create a sophisticated AI agent for sales outreach. It receives a list of prospects via webhook. For each prospect: use HTTP Request to scrape their LinkedIn profile and company website, extract key information with a Code node, use OpenAI to research their company and recent news, generate a personalized cold email referencing specific things about their business, score the email quality with a second AI call, if score is above 8 queue it in Gmail as a draft for review, if below 8 regenerate with feedback. Track all prospects in a Postgres table with status and outreach history. Use Loop Over Items with delays between prospects to avoid rate limits. Send a daily Slack report of emails drafted and their quality scores.
